evidence.label: Structured product evidence 2

evidence.label: VentureDex product record
evidence.source: content/startups/antora-energy.json summary, editor_note, funding, and research fields

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 1
evidence.source: Antora says its thermal battery resistively heats solid carbon to as high as 2,400°C, stores that energy for multiple days, and can return it as industrial heat or electricity through a steam turbine.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 2
evidence.source: The official technology surface says factory-built modules scale from megawatts to gigawatts and use domestic, earth-abundant solid carbon rather than supply-constrained critical minerals.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 3
evidence.source: Project Big Stone is a 5 GWh, 50 MW thermal-battery project with more than 200 modules under a POET energy offtake agreement; Antora says it advanced from an empty lot to first energy delivery in under 12 months.

risks: Research risk candidate: The falsifiable risk is whether Antora can repeat Project Big Stone's sub-12-month delivery pace and economics across different industrial sites and duty cycles.

evidence.label: VentureDex product record
evidence.source: content/startups/soundhealth.json summary, editor_note, funding, and research fields

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 1
evidence.source: The SONU product page offers direct checkout and a 30-day risk-free trial, identifies SONU as FDA 510(k) cleared, and says its app creates a 3D facial and sinus map to tune acoustic resonance delivered by bone-conduction transducers.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 2
evidence.source: The Spatial Sleep product page offers direct checkout and a 45-day risk-free trial, and describes an app-generated 3D cranial map used to calculate personalized frequencies delivered through a forehead-worn bone-conduction band.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 3
evidence.source: The Series A release says SONU has delivered more than 500,000 acoustic-resonance sessions and that the same craniofacial dataset underpins Spatial Sleep.

risks: Research risk candidate: The falsifiable risk is whether congestion and sleep outcomes replicate in independent, long-duration, real-world cohorts; FDA clearance for SONU must not be generalized to Spatial Sleep.

evidence.label: VentureDex product record
evidence.source: content/startups/discern-security.json summary, editor_note, funding, and research fields

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 1
evidence.source: The official site says Atlas turns plain-English questions into dashboards, charts, and reusable queries, while Pathfinder prioritizes vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and assets using business context.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 2
evidence.source: The official site says Resolve converts findings into tracked remediation actions with approvals and accountability, and Mesh aligns policy and coverage across connected security tools.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 3
evidence.source: The platform release says Scout converts vendor best practices into measurable health checks and Mesh identifies cross-stack policy and MITRE coverage gaps.

risks: Research risk candidate: The falsifiable risk is whether Discern can deliver safe, measurable cross-vendor remediation improvements in production instead of adding another exposure dashboard layer.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 1
evidence.source: The CEREBO page describes a portable, non-invasive intracranial-hemorrhage screening device that uses diffuse reflectance and near-infrared spectroscopy with machine-learning interpretation.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 2
evidence.source: Bioscan presents Value, Plus, and Cloud configurations, with patient-history storage in Plus and application plus web access in the Cloud tier.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 3
evidence.source: The official patent surface describes passive self-alignment, safe optical switching, and multi-probe mechanisms intended to improve placement and measurement consistency.

risks: Research risk candidate: The falsifiable risk is whether independent clinical studies show sufficient sensitivity and specificity for safe deployment across populations and care settings beyond India.

evidence.label: VentureDex product record
evidence.source: content/startups/sofab-inks.json summary, editor_note, funding, and research fields

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 1
evidence.source: Sofab says Tinfab is a solution-processable SnO2 electron-transport layer that supports PIN and NIP architectures, multiple coating methods, and cells above 20% efficiency.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 2
evidence.source: The Tinfab page says the ink remains stable for more than two years and is available as an orderable sample rather than only as a laboratory formulation.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 3
evidence.source: Sofab says its tunable NiOx Nicfab layer is three times more durable than PTAA and has produced an 18% efficient full-metal-oxide cell.

risks: Research risk candidate: The falsifiable risk is whether reported cell efficiency and durability translate into module-scale yield, customer qualification, and high-volume production economics.
